thought.text: The infrastructure services registered on `websecure` because I started them without the env var. Let me recreate them properly with the `_compose` environment:

reasoning_content:
The keycloak router uses websecure entrypoint (which requires TLS). Since no Porkbun keys, we're on HTTP. The compose file labels have entrypoints `${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}` which should have been set to `web` via _compose. But it was set... wait, keycloak-health uses web. The keycloak router using websecure. Let me check - the justfile passes TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT="web" to compose. So the labels should be web. But the router created earlier when I ran `docker compose up -d keycloak` directly (without env) defaulted to websecure.

Let me recreate all services via `just _compose up -d`.

Actually the issue is the infra services other than reverse-proxy were started without the TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT env, so they registered on websecure. Let me recreate them via just _compose.

But valhalla/streamlet need the resource override. Let me recreate all with proper env.

Actually, my main goal is installation success. The core installation: setup, build, migrations all done. The services via docker - there's an infrastructure limitation with cgroup v2 threaded mode preventing resource limits. This is environmental.

But I've managed to get around it with override. Let me now recreate the services with proper traefik entrypoint so routing works, to have a fully working stack.

Let me recreate keycloak, pgadmin via just _compose (with override for valhalla/streamlet).

Actually the override is needed because of cgroup limit. Let me create a proper override file in workspace (but not commit it? The task is installation, modifying compose is an extra action). Let me use /tmp override with just _compose. But just _compose has fixed -f compose.yaml. I can't add -f easily. But I can call docker compose directly with the env vars.

Let me create the override file and invoke docker compose with env. Actually simpler: set env vars and run docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/override.yaml up -d.

Let me recreate keycloak and pgadmin with correct entrypoint.

action.command: cd /workspace && APP_HOST="localhost" BIND_ADDR="127.0.0.1" TRAEFIK_CONFIG="traefik-no-tls.yaml" TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT="web" APP_PROTO="http" APP_PORT="3000" PORKBUN_API_KEY="" PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY="" APP_VERSION="94229d0" APP_GIT_COMMIT="94229d0" APP_GIT_BRANCH="HEAD" APP_BUILD_TIME="2026-10-04T14:00:00Z" docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/override.yaml up -d keycloak pgadmin valhalla streamlet 2>&1 | tail -20
